run_ParlAIChecker: run the ParlAIChecker flake8 plugin to check a Python file for shebang, docstring, and copyright issues
check_python_shebang: check if a Python file has the required python3 shebang using the ParlAIChecker PAI100 rule
check_docstring_formatting: check if docstrings in a Python file need reformatting using the ParlAIChecker PAI101 rule
check_copyright_header: check if a Python file has the required Facebook copyright header using the ParlAIChecker PAI20x rules
review_ParlAIChecker: review the ParlAIChecker class and its run method to understand custom flake8 linting rules for ParlAI
